description: Attack a mathematical problem by importing powerful techniques from adjacent fields in the spirit of Noga Alon: probabilistic method, polynomial method, algebraic encodings, topological theorems, spectral tools, entropy, combinatorial geometry, coding theory, additive combinatorics, and related transfer principles. Use this skill when a direct proof route is stale, when the problem has a combinatorial surface but may be encoded into algebra, topology, probability, geometry, or linear algebra, or when the goal is to develop a new proof technique by adapting a theorem from another domain.
